units.id: news:avgi student happy|"Enthusiasm. I can't wait to go into academia after I graduate! I have a position lined up and everything!"|307|0
units.english: "Enthusiasm. I can't wait to go into academia after I graduate! I have a position lined up and everything!"
units.italian: "Entusiasmo. Non vedo l'ora di entrare nell'accademia dopo la laurea! Ho già un posto che mi aspetta!"

units.id: news:avgi student happy|"Gratitude. The appearance of those humans got me the funding I needed to complete my xenology mastery. Thank you, humanity!"|308|0
units.english: "Gratitude. The appearance of those humans got me the funding I needed to complete my xenology mastery. Thank you, humanity!"
units.italian: "Gratitudine. L'arrivo di quegli umani mi ha procurato i fondi che mi servivano per completare la laurea magistrale in xenologia. Grazie, umanità!"

units.id: news:avgi student happy|"Joy. Midterms are finally over!"|309|0
units.english: "Joy. Midterms are finally over!"
units.italian: "Gioia. Gli esami intermedi sono finalmente finiti!"

units.id: news:avgi student happy|"Have you seen my homework, question?"|310|0
units.english: "Have you seen my homework, question?"
units.italian: "Hai visto i miei compiti, domanda?"

units.id: news:avgi student happy|"My professor refused to believe me when I said an Aberrant ate my homework, amusement."|311|0
units.english: "My professor refused to believe me when I said an Aberrant ate my homework, amusement."
units.italian: "Il mio professore si è rifiutato di credermi quando ho detto che un Aberrant si è mangiato i miei compiti, divertimento."

units.id: news:avgi student happy|"Annoyance. The quality of education out here just isn't the same as back on Aviskir."|312|0
units.english: "Annoyance. The quality of education out here just isn't the same as back on Aviskir."
units.italian: "Fastidio. La qualità dell'istruzione qui non è proprio la stessa che ad Aviskir."

units.id: news:avgi student happy|"Annoyance. The quality of education out here just isn't the same as back on Livloua."|313|0
units.english: "Annoyance. The quality of education out here just isn't the same as back on Livloua."
units.italian: "Fastidio. La qualità dell'istruzione qui non è proprio la stessa che a Livloua."

units.id: news:avgi student frustrated|"Frustration. I wanted to study political science, but all they teach out here is 'practical' subjects. And people wonder why the Assembly is filled with incompetents..."|335|0
units.english: "Frustration. I wanted to study political science, but all they teach out here is 'practical' subjects. And people wonder why the Assembly is filled with incompetents..."
units.italian: "Frustrazione. Volevo studiare scienze politiche, ma qui insegnano solo materie 'pratiche'. E poi ci si chiede perché l'Assemblea sia piena di incompetenti..."

units.id: news:avgi student frustrated|"Depression. I was going to study linguistics, but the university made me go into engineering instead. We already have enough engineers, what we need out here is culture!"|336|0
units.english: "Depression. I was going to study linguistics, but the university made me go into engineering instead. We already have enough engineers, what we need out here is culture!"
units.italian: "Abbattimento. Volevo studiare linguistica, ma l'università mi ha fatto passare a ingegneria. Abbiamo già abbastanza ingegneri, qui ci serve cultura!"

units.id: news:avgi student frustrated|"Anger. I wanted to study the arts, but I was ridiculed and accused of being a dead weight on society. Well, a society without art is no society at all!"|337|0
units.english: "Anger. I wanted to study the arts, but I was ridiculed and accused of being a dead weight on society. Well, a society without art is no society at all!"
units.italian: "Rabbia. Volevo studiare arte, ma mi hanno deriso e accusato di essere un peso morto per la società. Beh, una società senza arte non è una società!"

units.id: news:avgi student frustrated|"Anger. I wanted to study sociology, but that apparently isn't 'useful' to the War. Fools, the lot of them!"|338|0
units.english: "Anger. I wanted to study sociology, but that apparently isn't 'useful' to the War. Fools, the lot of them!"
units.italian: "Rabbia. Volevo studiare sociologia, ma a quanto pare non è 'utile' alla Guerra. Sciocchi, tutti quanti!"

units.id: news:avgi student frustrated|"Worry. I hope I can find a good job once I'm out of school, but I might have to just work in the shipyards for a few years."|339|0
units.english: "Worry. I hope I can find a good job once I'm out of school, but I might have to just work in the shipyards for a few years."
units.italian: "Preoccupazione. Spero di trovare un buon lavoro appena finita la scuola, ma potrei dover lavorare nei cantieri per qualche anno."

units.id: news:avgi student frustrated|"Worry. I don't think I did well on that last exam."|340|0
units.english: "Worry. I don't think I did well on that last exam."
units.italian: "Preoccupazione. Non credo di aver fatto bene all'ultimo esame."
